style: Disciplined, counter-attacking CONCACAF side under Thomas Christiansen. Sit deep, defend in numbers and strike quickly on the break through clinical forwards and the creativity of Carrasquilla.
recent_form: Reached the World Cup and opened Group L with a 0-1 loss to Ghana, leaving them with work to do against England and Croatia. Competitive in recent CONCACAF play.

key_players.name: Adalberto Carrasquilla
key_players.note: Panama's most technically gifted midfielder and engine; dictates tempo and supplies the forwards.

key_players.name: Aníbal Godoy
key_players.note: Panama's most-capped player ever with 159 appearances; veteran leader and midfield organiser.

key_players.name: Michael Amir Murillo
key_players.note: Besiktas full-back and the team's main attacking outlet down the right.

key_players.name: José Fajardo
key_players.note: Clinical finisher who scores in bunches in CONCACAF competition.

key_players.name: Ismael Díaz
key_players.note: Sharp, mobile attacker offering goal threat on the counter.

key_players.name: Cecilio Waterman
key_players.note: Direct striker with recent scoring form for the national team.

historical_news: Panama opened Group L with a 0-1 defeat to Ghana.
Drawn in a tough Group L alongside England, Croatia and Ghana.
Captain Aníbal Godoy is Panama's most-capped player of all time with 159 appearances.
Carrasquilla regarded as one of the most technically gifted midfielders in CONCACAF.
Coached by Thomas Christiansen, relying on a counter-attacking blueprint.

media_sentiment.label: neutral
media_sentiment.summary: Cautious outlook after an opening loss; admired for organisation and counter-attacking but facing long odds in a strong group.
